$comment: Schema v2, the live schema extract.py validates against. x-filled-by says who writes each field: llm = the extraction prompt, code = extract.py, tagger = the two tagging calls assembled by code, external = populated after extraction outside the LLM. See docs/schema_v2.md.
title: HireDocument

source_file.description: Name of the crawled Markdown file this record was extracted from.

extracted_by_model.description: SOCLAAS model that extracted this record: one of MODEL_POOL in classifier_extractor/llm_pool.py.

hirer_ref.description: Synthetic id of the hirer posting the gig. One hirer can post several gigs, so records sharing a hirer_ref belong to the same hirer. Today every record is its own hirer.

source_company.description: Name of the publisher of the crawled page. Metadata only; never shown in the gig.

source_company_team.description: Name of the team on the crawled page if available, otherwise null. Metadata only.

gig_title.description: 3-10 words naming the TASK, not a job title or a person (e.g. "Food Safety Audit for Central Kitchen").

short_description.description: The gig as the hirer would post it, 55-120 words per the detail roll, in a Singapore setting, written as a public post: a one-line overview of the organisation or the need (no backstory), the ask and the work, then a sentence naming the deliverable (labelled "Deliverable:" or in plain words) and last a sentence starting "Engagement duration:" (1-8 weeks).

duration_weeks_min.description: Parsed from the "Engagement duration:" sentence. An LLM estimate, not a source fact.

duration_weeks_max.description: Parsed from the "Engagement duration:" sentence; equal to the minimum for a single value such as "4 weeks".

additional_notes.description: Budget, timeline or seniority expectations, only when the source states them. Almost always null.

tags.description: SkillsFuture tags, nested category -> specialisation -> skills. Assembled by code from two flat model replies and validated against data/reference/skillsfuture/, so every name is a real sector, track or skill. Empty categories list when nothing fits.

group.description: Which heading the platform's Category list shows this category under. Left null by the extractor; populated afterwards from the platform's own category list, never by the LLM.

name.description: A SkillsFuture track listed under this sector.

skills.description: SkillsFuture TSC titles linked to this track. May be empty.
